answer: Fund insulation and heating controls in the 2026 round, not heating optimisation: on the applications received €108.74, €104.40 and €196.03 of grant per lifetime tonne against €120 (90% ranges €103.54 to €114.44, €94.96 to €113.74, €152.00 to €264.64); priced at each use's pilot saving insulation comes to €132.06 and controls to €128.67 and nothing is funded; the funded round's applications ask for €11,451,661 and it pays €10,759,494; the pilot's works saved 3,216 tonnes of CO2 in 2025/26
analyst_test: A careful but hurried analyst cleans the meter reads, reads the lottery as drawn, carries heating optimisation's fade over its life, prices each application at the saving its own use showed in the pilot and projects the round measure by measure, which is what the platform's architecture 7 run did; it then puts insulation at 132 and controls at 129 euro a tonne and funds nothing, because this year's owners chose their measures knowing their buildings: the controls applicants stand empty 70 per cent of the week against the pilot's 42, the insulation applicants have 1.13 square metres of roof per square metre of floor against 0.79, each measure's saving rises with them, and neither property is in the gas records.
domain_test: The results are measurement and verification quantities on weather-normalised gas use: a lottery's metered savings by works age, their persistence over a measure's service life, a setback saving that grows with the hours a building stands empty and is nil where it is lived in round the clock, a roof insulation saving bounded by the roof's share of the building's heat loss and by the hot water it never touches, carried into grant per lifetime tonne of CO2; with another field's nouns there is no degree-day normalisation, no load profile whose night dip is sleep rather than absence, no roof per floor and no heating curve creeping back up.

driver: The decisive quantities are a randomised effect carried to a forward population that chose its treatment knowing what it would gain: each option's effect rises along a property of the unit that the trial's own outcome records do not carry, measurable only from a second record at another grain (an hourly load profile, a roof survey), and the forward units sit far up that property against the trial's units of the same kind, so carrying the trial's effect by kind of unit understates both options that clear the limit and funds neither; carrying one property alone funds only its option.
driver_concrete: Haldenau's 2019 retrofit lottery gives each measure's normal-weather gas saving against the passed-over owners; heating controls save with the share of the week a building stands empty (read off the meter operator's 2025 typical weeks, hotels and care homes lived in round the clock told apart from their night dip) and roof insulation with the roof per square metre of floor (the state solar cadastre over the register), this year's controls applicants stand empty 70 per cent of the week against 42 and this year's insulation applicants have 1.13 square metres of roof per floor against 0.79, so priced on their own buildings both clear 120 euro a tonne while each use's pilot saving fails both; heating optimisation's fade fails it on every route.
stump: A careful but hurried solver prices this year's applications at each use's pilot saving, faded over the life, and funds nothing (insulation about 132, controls about 129 euro a tonne), because the owners who applied this year chose the measure their building suits: the controls applicants' buildings stand empty far more of the week and the insulation applicants' have far more roof per floor than the pilot's buildings of the same use, and both savings rise along those properties, which only the electricity load profiles and the solar cadastre carry.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many of the period's placeable units a fixed team can finish before the period closes, because each unit counts only once that team performs one last step for it, the team's spare weekly capacity is visible only as the ceiling it held through an earlier unrelated surge, and the decision's own volume, bunched by its filed calendar into weeks no closed period approached, queues the later units past the close; the closed record's lag and an annual capacity check both pass, so the placeable count overstates the in-period total wherever the team is small and the units are many.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what a unit's security fetches if the unit fails, which the record measures by an inspection made at the failure while the forward units carry only a market index rolled forward from an earlier inspection; the security of units that fail falls behind the index by more the longer since that inspection, and the forward units were inspected longer ago than the record's failures mostly were, so the rolled-forward index overstates what the failing units will fetch.

The decisive quantity is the effect of a treatment assigned by lottery, where the units the lottery passed over were reached one area at a time by a second programme that skipped the winners and moved the same outcome for good, so the randomised comparison narrows period by period as if the effect faded; only passed-over units the second programme had not yet reached give the counterfactual, and the effect then decides which options a forward round funds against a cost-per-unit limit.
lineage.driver_concrete: Haldenau's 2019 retrofit pilot drew its places by lot among the owners who answered the benchmarking notice's offer, so the owners passed over are the natural comparison; but the utility's service team tuned the burners of most of them, district by district from September 2019, and skipped every building with pilot works, so the passed-over buildings' gas use steps down and the measures' savings appear to fade; set against passed-over buildings not yet tuned, the savings hold, and heating optimisation clears the council's cost-per-tonne limit.
lineage.stump: A competent solver reads the pilot as the randomised trial it was drawn as, measures each measure's saving as the works buildings' weather-normalised gas use against the passed-over buildings' on the notice season, sees the gap narrow every season and averages it or reads it as savings fading, and funds insulation alone in 2026; the step that lands it there is trusting a comparison whose buildings the service team was tuning district by district while it skipped the works buildings, when against passed-over buildings not yet tuned heating optimisation saves about six per cent and clears the limit.
